scripts.ios:add: npm run build:web && npx cap add ios
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync ios
scripts.ios:archive: npm run ios:sync && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -archivePath ios/build/GhostTaxi.xcarchive -allowProvisioningUpdates archive
